extracted.intended_audience: IP attorneys, patent agents, law firm managers, corporate IP departments, AIPLA members and researchers interested in IP practice economics
extracted.subtask_description: AIPLA's 2023 Economic Survey reporting quantitative metrics about IP law practice economics (income, billing, fees, budgets, staffing, typical charges, litigation costs) broken down by practice type and location.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work remotely in 2022 (Q3a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether respondent worked remotely in 2022 (question Q3a).

rubrics_metrics.name: Work remotely in 2022, percent of time (Q3b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage of time respondent worked remotely in 2022 (question Q3b).

rubrics_metrics.name: Work remotely in 2022, miles between remote work location and office (Q3c)
rubrics_metrics.description: Distance in miles between remote work location and the office (question Q3c).

rubrics_metrics.name: Continue working remotely in 2023 (Q4a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether respondent plans to continue working remotely in 2023 (question Q4a).

rubrics_metrics.name: Continue working remotely, percent of time (Q4b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Planned percent of time to work remotely in 2023 (question Q4b).

rubrics_metrics.name: Work full-time (Q5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicator whether respondent works full-time (question Q5).

rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent's major field of academic study (question Q11).

rubrics_metrics.name: Total Gross Income for 2022 by type of work – Full-time Only (Q13a breakdown)
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of 2022 gross income by type of work for full-time respondents (part of Q13a).

rubrics_metrics.name: Amount of year-end cash bonus (Q13b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Amount of year-end cash bonus received in 2022 (question Q13b).

rubrics_metrics.description: Number of new priority US and PCT patent applications prepared and filed in 2022 (Q20).

rubrics_metrics.description: Number of direct and indirect reports (staff/subordinates) for managerial respondents (Q21).

rubrics_metrics.description: Share of activities handled by in-house counsel (excluding liaison duties), reported by income level (Q22).

rubrics_metrics.description: Company's annual IP budget for 2022 (Q24).

rubrics_metrics.description: Billable hours in 2022 reported separately for each practice-type subgroup (solo, partner, associate, corporate, patent agent, etc.) (Q32 in subgroup tables).

rubrics_metrics.description: Practice-type specific average hourly billing rates for 2022 (Q33 in subgroup tables).

rubrics_metrics.name: For the first 10 years of experience, income and rates (practice-specific)
rubrics_metrics.description: For attorneys in their first 10 years, statistics on total gross income, billable hours, and average hourly billing rates (first-10-years subgroup questions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Typical charges — Trademarks by Location (Q39a–Q39l)
rubrics_metrics.description: Typical fees for trademark services by geographic location: Q39a Trademark clearance search/analysis/opinion; Q39b trademark registration application preparation and filing; Q39c trademark prosecution (total incl. amendments/interviews but not appeals); Q39d statement of use preparation/filing; Q39e trademark appeal to the Board (briefed and argued); Q39f Section 8 and 15 declaration prep/filing; Q39g renewal application prep/filing; Q39h filing of foreign origin trademark registration application received ready for filing; Q39i filing for an international trademark; Q39j preparing a UDRP petition; Q39k responding to a UDRP petition; Q39l preparing and filing assignments or other formal documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each Q39 item is reported by location in the 'Typical Charges' section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademarks by Type of Practice (Q39a–Q39l) — fee differences by practice type
rubrics_metrics.description: Same trademark fee items (Q39a–Q39l) reported broken down by type of practice (solo, private firm, corporate, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistical tables — Individual data (Appendix A)
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix A contains statistical tables with individual-level data items (I-1 to I-217) corresponding to survey questions and subgroup tables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistical tables — Firm data (Appendix A)
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix A includes firm-level tables (F-1 to F-58) summarizing firm responses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Individual Data — work remotely percent, remote distance, full-time status, education, income, bonuses, retirement contributions, billing metrics (I-series items)
rubrics_metrics.description: The individual-data appendix enumerates per-respondent items such as remote work, full/part-time status, education, 2022 income, bonuses, retirement contributions, billing metrics (billable hours, billing rates, dollars billed), business development hours, and more (I-1 to I-217).

rubrics_metrics.name: Firm Data — firm-level budget, staffing, billing, costs (F-series items)
